title: E-fuels Supply Potentials: Scenario Results and Input Data for North American Energy Transition Modeling
description: Archive of scenario results and input data for the e-fuels supply potentials project, modeling North American energy transition pathways with sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) mandates. Contains 10 scenario runs (US_scenario_01 through US_scenario_10), each with solved network files (network.nc) and solver logs, plus the ERA5 cutout used for renewable resource assessment.
